text: At start the help list (W A S D walk...) is drawn on top of Nana's greeting text at the bottom; both are unreadable where they overlap.
Fix 1/2: on Nana's porch facing the window lantern the prompt reads 'E light Nana's window lantern' and the crosshair turns orange; a step further back it said 'come closer to light it'.

Lantern lit with E: Lanterns 1 of 4, NEXT moved on to 'Knock (E) where a porch light is on: 8 to go', marker '30 m >' at right edge. But the 'Choose a costume: 1 ghost 2 pumpkin...' line is still on screen after the witch was chosen and the lantern lit.

After Mrs. Okafor asks me to light Grandpa Ike's lantern at the end of the porch, NEXT updates but no wayfinding marker (no v distance, no side arrow) appears; the glowing jack-o-lantern at the porch's right end gives no prompt and E does nothing on it. Only 'You have been here tonight' shows.
Notebook page 'Samhain' overflows: text runs to the bottom edge and the page footer (Page x of 4 / Left/Right turn / Tab close) that page 2 shows is missing, so the last line(s) may be cut.

Wayfinding marker 'v 6 m' is drawn on top of the HUD stat block (Basket/Smoke lines) when the goal is up-left; both become hard to read. Same when looking down: the distance label clips off the top edge.

Fix 5: after Q back to Wren, NEXT says 'Fetch your candy bag from where you changed (E)'; the bag is visible on the ground with a warm glint and 'E pick up your candy bag'. No floating label on the bag itself, and as the cat the bag was not obvious (looked down, nothing; only spotted it on a step behind).
Fix 5 (as cat): from a few metres away the dropped bag shows a floating 'Your candy bag' label. Good. Faint teal dots on the dark ground nearby (paw prints?) are very hard to see on the dark lawn.

Reached the herb-bed marker as the cat behind Nana's house: the marker disappears at ~3 m but NEXT still says 'follow them from Nana's herb bed'; the yard is near-black and I can't see any glowing paw prints, the herb bed itself, or a next marker. Not clear where to go.

As the cat near Nana's house the herb-bed marker keeps flipping: shows '4 m >' at the right edge, I turn right ~90 degrees and it still says '4 m >', then strafing it vanishes. Nothing on screen marks the herb bed and NEXT never advances. ~4 game-hours of night spent circling Nana's yard (7:16 to 8:15 pm).

Followed the faint teal paw-print line away from Nana's yard (toward the church steeple) as the cat; the wayfinding marker keeps pointing BACK to the herb bed (33 m, then 66 m) and NEXT never changes, so the marker actively pulls you off the trail. In the dark lawn the prints fade out after ~20 m and I lost them. 9:07 pm, porch lights out, Smoke not found.
